description: Read a recorded decision (GET /v1/events/{id}), including a REVIEW. finalDecision is REVIEW while the review is pending, then ALLOW after approval or BLOCK after denial or expiry. decision itself does not change. The finalDecision field is the authoritative result. waitMs polls until finalDecision is ALLOW or BLOCK, or until the bounded wait elapses (30 seconds maximum). waitTimedOut is true when the wait ended and finalDecision is still REVIEW. This does not approve or deny the review.

id.description: Decision id returned by decide_action or check_mcp_tool_call.

waitMs.description: When finalDecision is REVIEW, the server polls until finalDecision is ALLOW or BLOCK, or until this many milliseconds pass. Maximum 30000. 0, or omitting the field, returns the current decision immediately.

name: get_decision

finalDecision.description: Authoritative result. Allowed values: ALLOW, REVIEW, BLOCK.

waitTimedOut.description: True when the wait elapsed and finalDecision is still REVIEW.

title: Get decision
